title: PrimeBan
description: This is a simple ban plugin
body:
# PrimeBan

PrimeBan is a modern moderation system for Minecraft servers and networks running Paper and Velocity.

It provides punishments, reports, staff tools, voice chat moderation, network-wide bans, logs, Discord alerts, SQL storage, and configurable moderation workflows in one clean plugin system.

## Features

- Permanent bans and temporary bans
- IP bans
- Permanent mutes and temporary mutes
- IP mutes
- Simple Voice Chat voice mutes
- IP voice mutes
- Warnings and kicks
- Punishment history
- Player notes
- Reports with GUI
- Report pages, filters, sorting, and priority labels
- Team chat
- Freeze and unfreeze system
- Vanish system
- Staff moderation GUI
- Punishment preset GUI
- Configurable punishment presets
- Preset permissions for staff groups
- Staff activity tracking
- Alt-account detection through IP history
- Staff join alerts
- Moderation logs with GUI views
- SQLite support
- MySQL/MariaDB support
- Paper + Velocity support
- Velocity login ban checks
- Discord webhook embeds
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Optional Redis Pub/Sub sync
- Configurable messages and permissions

## Paper + Velocity

PrimeBan is split into two plugins:

- **PrimeBan-Paper** for in-game moderation features
- **PrimeBan-Velocity** for proxy-side network moderation

Both plugins can use the same database, allowing punishments and moderation data to sync across the network.

## Simple Voice Chat Support

PrimeBan integrates with the Simple Voice Chat API.

Voice mutes are separate from normal chat mutes, so staff can punish voice chat abuse without muting normal text chat.

Supported voice commands:

```text
/voicemute <player> [reason]
/tempvoicemute <player> <time> [reason]
/ipvoicemute <player> [reason]
/voiceunmute <player>
/voicecheck <player>
